This notebook writes `rproject.toml` and `pyproject.toml`.

Do not run `rv sync` or `uv sync` here.

Here's the default set of R and Python packages I'll typically have; make it
leaner for faster builds, and add more as needed for your project. Bounce
between this notebook and the Spack environment notebook to add any
system dependencies you need for your R and Python packages.

```{python}
#| sorting-hat: remove
from rse_workbench.datascience import (
    default_pyproject,
    default_rproject,
    write_pyproject_toml,
    write_rproject_toml,
)
```



```{python}
#| sorting-hat: remove
rproject = default_rproject(
    project_name=project_contract.project_name,
    r_version=project_contract.r_version,
    packages=list(set(DEFAULT_R_PACKAGES)),
    git_dependencies=DEFAULT_R_GIT_DEPENDENCIES,
)

pyproject = default_pyproject(
    project_name=project_contract.project_name,
    python_version=project_contract.python_version,
    packages=list(set(DEFAULT_PYTHON_PACKAGES)),
)

write_rproject_toml(project_contract.rproject_toml, rproject)
write_pyproject_toml(project_contract.pyproject_toml, pyproject)
```
